d: We are currently seeking an experienced Production Director to lead and optimize manufacturing operations at our Bahrain facility.

The Production Director will be responsible for overseeing all manufacturing activities within the plant, ensuring operational excellence across Production, Supply Chain, Planning, and Quality functions. The role requires a strong leader with proven experience in complex OEM manufacturing environments, capable of driving efficiency, quality, productivity, and continuous improvement initiatives.
The successful candidate will play a key role in the achievement of business objectives, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
q: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
+ 10 years of experience in manufacturing leadership roles.
Proven experience in OEM manufacturing environments.
Strong background in Production Management, Supply Chain, Planning, and Quality.
Demonstrated success in Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, and Operational Excellence programs.
Strong leadership, communication, and people management skills.
Strategic mindset combined with a hands-on operational approach.
Experience in the power generation, industrial equipment, machinery, metal fabrication, or electromechanical manufacturing sectors.
Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, and World Class Manufacturing methodologies.
